headline: Painting the Town Green

result.label: “Greener by Design” · year to date
result.note: Direction only — the client publishes no figure

summary: A regional paint maker under attack from a national competitor. A deep dive found the differentiator nobody was using: the first and only LEED Gold-certified paint manufacturer.

question.p: Regional paint manufacturer Dunn-Edwards faced inroads from a major competitor in Northern California and needed fresh thinking to better differentiate itself.

found.h: The first and only LEED Gold paint maker.
found.p: Through a deep dive into this challenger brand’s product offerings, we discovered Dunn-Edwards is the first and only LEED Gold-certified paint manufacturer. This little-known fact created an important differentiator for consumers looking for a more sustainable brand.

made.p: “Greener by Design” developed as an ongoing digital and in-store campaign and is responsible for an increase in sales year to date.

rationale: A second pure diagnosis story after Gelson’s: the differentiator already existed inside the company; nobody had found it. Strong support for the “we find out” promise.
